info.title: Post Engineer API
info.description: Generate and schedule short videos for social accounts. Authenticate with an API key created in the dashboard: Authorization: Bearer <key>.

reason.description: The engine rejection reason, on 400 ENGINE_REJECTED only (capped at 200 chars, secrets and local paths redacted).

errors.description: Up to 20 validation problems (generate-and-schedule 400 only). The first entry matches the top-level code, error and field.

cta.description: Marks the take that performs this video's CTA (issue #639).

auth_url.description: https URL to open in a browser.

422.description: Bluesky rejected the handle or app password (code BLUESKY_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED).
3Speak rejected the username or posting key (code THREESPEAK_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED).

403.description: The bot is not in the chat or cannot post there (code TELEGRAM_BOT_NOT_MEMBER or TELEGRAM_BOT_CANNOT_POST).

404.description: Telegram could not find the chat (code TELEGRAM_CHAT_NOT_FOUND).

422.description: Telegram rejected the bot token (code TELEGRAM_TOKEN_REJECTED).

chatId.description: Public @username or numeric chat ID of the channel or group.

chatType.description: The destination kind; checked against the real chat.

image_url.description: Signed URL; null when signing failed (GET only).

image_url_error.description: true when image_url could not be signed (GET only).

outfit.description: Clothing only, one line per slot. one_piece cannot be combined with top or bottom. Nudity, sexualised clothing and words about the person (hair, skin, body) are rejected.

identityCard.description: Versioned identity card (at most 4096 bytes, every level strict, at least one identity trait). It describes a real person's physical traits: fill it only with their consent. Advice for the agent's image tool, not enforcement.

403.description: A persona-scoped API key that does not include this persona.

get.description: Reads the identity card of one persona. It is never part of the persona list or a share page.

prompt.description: The deterministic edit prompt; identity text comes only from the card.

suggestedDescription.description: A library description made from the outfit, setting, lighting and framing, never from the identity.

setting.description: Free text about the place. Words about the person (hair, skin, body) are rejected.

scene.description: Scene only (at most 2048 bytes). Identity, face, body and version keys are rejected.

post.description: Renders the image prompt for one scene from the stored card. Nothing is generated or stored: the prompt is advice for the agent's own image tool.

identityCard.description: The identity card as a JSON string (at most 4096 bytes). Send the JSON literal null on PATCH to clear it; omit the field to leave it unchanged.

avatarUrl.description: Exactly one of photo or avatarUrl on create.

409.description: The video upload was already used to publish, is already scheduled, or is not completed yet.

410.description: The video upload expired before publishing. Mint a new one.

413.description: The finished video is over the 2GB limit.

imageData.description: Base64 image bytes (JPEG or PNG, at most 8 MB).

publishAt.description: The one moment to publish (3h-30d ahead): with an offset, or wall-clock in timezone.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry with the same key: scheduled replays the schedule, asap replays the recorded posts per account.

personaIds.description: null: the page shows every persona. A list limits it to those personas.

url.description: The public link. Treat it as a secret: anyone who has it can read the page.

403.description: A persona-scoped API key cannot manage share links.

404.description: A persona in personaIds is unknown, or not yours.

409.description: You already have 10 active share links (SHARE_LINK_LIMIT).

personaIds.description: Limit the page to these personas. Omit for every persona.

expiresInDays.description: Omit for a link that never expires.

post.description: Creates a public read-only link (no login) to the metrics summary of the first 7 days and this week's posts. The token is returned once; only its hash is stored. At most 10 links can be active at a time.

delete.description: Revokes a share link at once. Revoking a revoked link succeeds with alreadyRevoked true.

body.description: Task record. state: -1 failed, 1 complete, 3 queued, 4 processing.

410.description: Terminal: the engine no longer has this task. Stop polling; GET /api/schedule/slots/{slotId} says whether the video was delivered or failed and refunded.

429.description: API-key and OAuth callers may poll one task at most once per minute; a faster poll answers errorType RATE_LIMITED and a Retry-After header with the seconds left. Wait that long before the next poll.

502.description: Engine unavailable or state unverifiable; retry with backoff.

refunds.description: Token refunds issued for cancelled slots.

get.description: slotId is the slot id returned by generate-and-schedule. The slot post detail fields are returned at the top level next to success.

slots.description: Range mode only: every slot with slot_at in [from, to).

truncated.description: Range mode only: true when the slot cap was hit.

body.description: Task record. state: -1 failed, 1 complete, 3 queued, 4 processing.

429.description: At most 10 cancels per minute per user; a faster call answers errorType RATE_LIMITED and a Retry-After header with the seconds left.

post.description: Provider-specific form fields (video file, title, caption) are read by the provider handler; see the MCP publish_video (action: from_file) tool.

413.description: Declared size over the 2GB video or 8 MB image limit.

502.description: The signed upload URL could not be created.

post.description: Mint a signed upload: returns the uploadId, the signedUrl to PUT the bytes to directly, and the expiry. The upload is bound to the caller and carries a video (capped at 2GB) or a JPEG/PNG image (capped at 8 MB) for the image networks.

409.description: The upload was already consumed, or changed while being verified.

410.description: The upload expired before completion. Mint a new one.

413.description: The stored video is over the 2GB limit.

post.description: Verify a signed upload after the PUT: the server checks the real content (magic bytes) and size, then marks it ready. Idempotent for an already-ready upload.

409.description: The upload is not completed yet, or was already used to publish.

410.description: The upload expired before publishing. Mint a new one.

413.description: The stored video is over the 2GB limit.

post.description: Publish a completed signed-upload video by uploadId — the remote replacement for publish_video (action: from_file). Single-use: one publish consumes the upload. Provider field rules mirror publish_video (action: from_file) (YouTube: title, description, tags, privacyStatus; Rumble/Fanvue: title, description; Pinterest: boardId plus description or caption; the rest: caption).

reason.description: The engine rejection reason, on a failed slot the engine rejected.

400.description: ENGINE_REJECTED: the engine rejected every video; reason names what to fix.

402.description: INSUFFICIENT_TOKENS: the balance does not cover the video.

409.description: PERSONA_ALREADY_SCHEDULED: this persona already has an active schedule. IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONSUMED: the idempotency key belongs to a deleted schedule; send a new key.

502.description: unreachable or transient engine error (401/403/429/5xx); no reason

personaId.description: Optional: a voiceover post needs no persona.

schedule.description: Required when mode is 'scheduled' (the default); forbidden when mode is 'asap'.

fullLipsync.description: Persona talks for the whole video, not only the hook. Not with voiceover.

promptVersionId.description: The versionId returned with the prompt (GET /api/prompts/[slug]) this script was written from. Experiments compare videos by prompt version; omit when the script was not written from a prompt.

cta.description: Per-video CTA override (issue #639): explicit wins over the persona default; null disables the CTA for this video.

404.description: SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND: a schedule does not exist, is not yours, or has no video.

409.description: BATCH_CONFLICT: a video already belongs to another batch; BATCH_WINDOW_EXCEEDED: the videos were not created within 10 minutes of the first.

segments.description: Segments in order: hook first, then content takes. 60-200 words in total.

fullLipsync.description: Optional. Media is optional when true (full lip sync); otherwise every segment needs a media list, about one image per ~2s, at most 30.

publishCheck.description: null for kind "script": caption limits do not apply to spoken text.

account.description: The one account that posts every video.

options.description: Shared video options: the generate-and-schedule options without videoType and segments.

startAt.description: ISO date-time of the earliest first post.

times.description: Posting times of day, HH:MM, in timezone.

variants.description: Prompt versions to compare. Each has the same number of videos (5-15, at most 40 in total, at most 20 when videoType is full_lipsync), each with its own script.

quoteKey.description: The quoteKey of the quote to confirm. Send it with expiresAt, or send neither to get a quote.

post.description: Runs a prompt comparison in two calls. Without quoteKey it is a quote: nothing is charged and the response carries the plan (one slot per video, the prompt versions rotated over the posting times), the total tokens, warnings, a quoteKey and its expiresAt (15 minutes). With the quoteKey and expiresAt of a quote it is the confirm: the total is charged once, one schedule with a slot per video is created and every video is started. A retry with the same quoteKey replays and never charges twice.
